verdict.rationale: Framer's own Server API is documented to "automate publishing", which gives a programmatic route to producing the live site, Framer's production output. Nothing in the evidence shows an agent rendering screenshots or images, or exporting design files or code. External agents are documented only as reading and writing canvas, components and CMS content, not exporting renders, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented screenshot/image rendering endpoint, export of designs to files or code formats, detailed API reference for publish/export, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can render and export designs — screenshots, images, or production formats — through a documented programmatic surface

citations.quote: Server API Connect your product and automate publishing with the Framer API.
Use the Server API to bring Framer into your product, or connect an external agent to work on a Framer project
